bluf: Jaywing is a UK integrated strategy, creative and media agency built on a 25 year data science heritage, selling to enterprise brands from Sheffield and Leeds, and owned since 2025-05 by the London fintech Stubben Edge Group after leaving AIM. The record shows it leaning into AI visibility research, a 200,000+ prompt LLM Visibility Study, while its own site publishes no llms.txt. The one thing a rival should know: all 16 clients on record are names only, the Horus read is Neutral at 7.8 with KJ6 as its exposure, and it is likely contestable on described work rather than on data credentials.
doing:
Jaywing positions itself as an integrated strategy, creative and media agency built on a 25 year data science heritage, pitching numbers led storytelling that moves leads, conversions and ROI: in plain words, a data business that grew a creative and media agency around its models. Its headline claim is a place among the top 10 integrated agencies in the North and a Campaign Integrated Agency of the Year finalist spot.

The mix is twelve services, from creative and brand strategy through media and data science to SEO, paid search, paid social, programmatic, PR and credit risk under Jaywing Risk. Data & Measurement leads at a score of 3: the title leads with data, it began as a specialist data business, and Data Science measures channel contribution. Three core lines score 2. AI Search / GEO rests on the LLM Visibility Study of 200,000+ prompts linking rankings to AI citations. Paid Search rests on 2026 Google Premier Partner status. SEO rests on guidance published by its Head of SEO Operations and Content Director. Proprietary assets: Decision, the Accelerator Lab, the LLM Visibility Study and Echelon, a credit scoring product; the one partner is Google Premier Partner (2026).

Its AI posture is research first: the prompt study, GEO guidance, AI in media planning and agentic AI commentary from the Accelerator Lab; AI Automation / Agents scores 1.

Moves in date order: 2024-01, a Northern Digital Awards win; 2025, de listing from AIM; 2025-05, UK operations acquired by Stubben Edge Group from Jaywing Limited; 2025-09, the Accelerator Lab shortlisted for Tech Team of the Year; 2025-10, PizzaExpress appointing it integrated marketing partner; 2026-03, 2026 Google Premier Partner; 2026-04, shortlisted for five Prolific North Champions Awards; 2026-09, Decision shortlisted after a £400k saving for Bensons for Beds. No pricing signal is recorded; absent: no case study describes the work, no jobs, and CRO, Email & CRM and Creator & Influencer at 0.
clients:
The record marks its client type as enterprise and lists ten verticals: financial services and banking, retail and ecommerce, automotive, utilities, FMCG and drinks, restaurants, education, energy and EV charging, technology, and parcels and logistics. The home market is the UK, with Sheffield and Leeds listed alongside Sydney and Melbourne.

The book holds 16 clients and every one is a name only: 8 case study pages, 7 case study slugs and 1 press release, none carrying a described result the needs read could code. The names span the verticals it lists: first direct, Virgin Money and Skipton Building Society in banking; ASDA, Hallmark, Stokke and END. in retail; Castrol, Mazda and Euro Car Parts (a press release titled the road to success) in automotive; Yorkshire Water and bp pulse (a home charging slug) in utilities and energy; Doritos in FMCG; PizzaExpress in restaurants; Bensons for Beds, whose slug records the £400k Decision saving; and Twitter in technology. The need for each is inferred from the data led integrated mix it sells; the record does not say what any of them came for.

Two clients sit on other tracked agencies' books: Yorkshire Water with mediaworks and Virgin Money with journey-further.

The read is most exposed to KJ6 (the agency middle is being hollowed out), driven by Paid Search and SEO with Data & Measurement offsetting, so it is likely, with moderate confidence, that the media and SEO hours these enterprise brands buy are squeezed first while the measurement line holds; KJ1 (the click is being replaced by the citation) is the tailwind, and the prompt study is the sign that these clients will ask for AI citation measurement next, which it has not yet shown as an audited product.
house: The record marks 2 of 3 say and do lines practised. AI Search / GEO is contradicted, the one gap listed: it sells AI visibility and publishes no llms.txt while its sitemap holds 5 AI topic URLs; no AI crawlers are blocked. Paid Search is corroborated by its own Google ads, 1 in the Transparency Center and 1 in the last 30 days. Publishing cadence is marked corroborated on 1 sitemap URL updated in 90 days and 20 in 365 out of 553, near idle. The tag stack is gtm alone on Umbraco, with no social pixel, test tool or ABM stack. Its Google Ads Transparency Center record shows 1 text ad under Jaywing PLC, last shown 2026-09-27. Its LinkedIn record shows 2 company ads and 0 thought leader ads; one sample reads "We asked the internet to watch tea brew for four minutes and they actually did it". No Meta or TikTok check is recorded.
market:
The Horus read puts Jaywing at a tailwind index of 7.8, band Neutral. It is best placed for KJ1 (the click is being replaced by the citation) at net 0.312, driven by AI Search / GEO and Paid Search, and for KJ2 at 0.25; it is most exposed to KJ6 (the agency middle is being hollowed out) at -0.723, driven by Paid Search and SEO with Data & Measurement offsetting, and KJ5 at -0.096. The best scenario fit is The Walled Oasis at 46/100. It is making P4 (inputs for automation); P1 is partial; P2, P6, P7 and P8 are absent; P5 unknown; P3 does not apply.

The Monsoon read is 59.9, band Onshore wind, migration 69.9 against displacement 49.9, observed via the large term, holdco inferred, the enterprise ICP pulling down. 55 of the index is the sold mix, SEO (13) and Data & Measurement (10) most movable; the shore split is 65% South and Southeast Asia, 20% Eastern Europe, 15% Africa and the Maghreb, and automation overlaps 20%. No hub office or onshore claim is listed.
openings:
The strongest opening is the book. All 16 clients are names without described work, so it is likely, with moderate confidence, that a rival bringing a described measurement or media result can contest first direct, Virgin Money, Skipton Building Society or ASDA on evidence. The falsifier is a captured Jaywing case page describing work and outcome for any of them.

The contradiction to lead with is AI visibility: it publishes a 200,000+ prompt LLM Visibility Study and no llms.txt on its own site, and P1 is partial with no audited citation product in the record, so a rival turning the same research into a tracked number for a named client likely wins the GEO conversation. P2 is absent, so the feed, schema and entity layer is unclaimed under a data led agency.

The judgment exposure is KJ6 with P5 unknown, so a transparent outcome priced offer against media and SEO hours is a conversation it cannot have in public, and P8 is absent, so the first agency in its segment with results from ads inside AI assistants sets the price. Displacement at 49.9 says the book is not bought on price: the undercutting offer is proof, not rate.
watch: Indicator I8, holdco Q3 organic growth, headcount and pricing model disclosures, next reading October 2026: output or outcome pricing announced at a top five holdco would sharpen its KJ6 exposure while its own pricing stays unpublished under Stubben Edge Group.

Indicator I2, Alphabet Q3 2026 search growth and AI Mode ad disclosures, next reading late October 2026: growth below 10% flags cannibalization of its SEO line, while above 15% with AI Mode ads live confirms S1 and the citation thesis of its prompt study.

Indicator I10, Reddit US daily users against search referral volatility, next reading late October 2026: US DAUq growth at or below 5% alongside AI Mode growth confirms the UGC starvation risk behind KJ1.

Indicator I3, OpenAI ad run rate disclosures and CPM trend, rolling: the $2B milestone and pricing below $20 CPM would tell whether its KJ2 tailwind reaches a media agency that has not tested ads inside assistants.

Follow up the dated moves: the Decision shortlist of 2026-09 after the £400k Bensons for Beds saving and the PizzaExpress appointment of 2025-10, since a published result for either would give the record its first described work.
